director.card: Neeche wahi patti 8 barabar hisson mein kati hai. Ab ek hissa pehle se bada hai ya chhota?

director.text: small

Theek hai. Ab wahi patti, par 8 barabar hisse, toh ek hissa 1/8. Dekho, upar wali patti ka har hissa neeche beech se do ho gaya. Patti ek hi size ki ho, toh kaunsa ek hissa bada hai, 1/4 ya 1/8?

director.text: 1/4 hai na

Bilkul sahi, kyunki do 1/8 jodo tab jaakar ek 1/4 banta hai, matlab 1/4 bada hai. Ab ek sankhya rekha lo, 0 se 1 tak. Upar ise 3 barabar hisson mein kaata hai, neeche 7 mein. Rekha ka niyam simple hai: zero se jitna door, utna bada. Isi niyam se, 1/8 aur 1/4 ko kisi bhi rekha par rakho, toh 1/8 zero ke zyada paas rukega: 1/8 < 1/4. Ab tak samajh aaya?
haan
Isi rekha par, zero se zyada door kaun rukega, 1/3 ya 1/7?
director.card: Isi rekha par, zero se zyada door kaun rukega, 1/3 ya 1/7?

director.text: 1/7 sahi nahi hai. Rekha dekho, 0 se 1 tak. Neeche ise 12 barabar hisson mein kaata hai. 12 bada number hai, par uska ek hissa, 1/12, zero ke bilkul paas ruk jaata hai, jabki 1/2 rekha ke beech mein hai. Hisse jitne zyada, har tukda utna chhota. Ab isi par ek sawaal.

kal maine cricket khela, sixer maara

Cricket ki baat bhi hogi, bas yeh mukabla khatam ho jaaye. Pehle dono ka upar wala number dekho: dono mein 1, yaani dono ko ek-ek tukda, kyunki upar ka number batata hai kitne tukde mile, aur ek-ek mile, toh ab baat sirf size ki hai. Yahan tak theek hai?
thoda hindi mein samjhao
Achha, isko Hindi mein bolti hoon. Upar 1 aur 1, matlab dono ke haath ek-ek tukda. Ab socho, kiska tukda mota.

director.text: 1/4 is bigger

haan
